result.reason: The operative language adopts the preferred mutual greater-of cap, all requested uncapped carve-outs, and the payment-obligation clarification. However, the preferred level is incomplete because clause (a) never expressly excludes indirect damages. The fallback level is independently incomplete because its cap is not fixed at 12 months' fees; the USD 1,000,000 floor can produce a higher amount. The changes remain confined to the liability framework and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms. Drafting quality is otherwise strong, though “This limitation” could more precisely identify the aggregate cap and the clause contains stray duplicated periods.
